_comment: Recurring IT/CH demand peaks. score.py proposes the related guide or freshness update 4-8 weeks before a peak, and only when (1) owner_reviewed_on is set, (2) the entry's status is 'checked' and (3) checked_for_year equals the year of the coming peak. Every date needs an official source, re-checked every year. The agent never edits this file.
OWNER_READ_REQUIRED: One-time read by the owner: check each date and source, then set owner_reviewed_on to the date of your read. Until then no seasonal candidate is made.

entries.title: IMU, saldo
entries.source_note: L. 160/2019 art. 1 c. 762 (text in force, read 2026-11-22): instalments due 16 June and 16 December. 16 Dec 2026 is a Wednesday, no shift.

entries.title: IMU, acconto
entries.source_note: Same comma 762: first instalment or single payment by 16 June. 16 Jun 2027 is a Wednesday, no shift.

entries.title: 730 precompilato: consultation opens
entries.source_note: 2026 campaign: available from 30 April, sending from 14/15 May (the two AdE pages disagree), deadline 30 September. Re-check when AdE publishes the 2027 calendar.

entries.title: Redditi PF: deadline
entries.source_note: DPR 322/1998 art. 2 c. 1: online filing by 31 October. 31 Oct 2027 is a Sunday and 1 Nov is Ognissanti (L. 260/1949 art. 2), so DL 70/2011 art. 7 moves it to Tue 2 Nov 2027. The date moves every year: re-check before each campaign.

entries.title: New IRPEF brackets after the budget law
entries.source_note: Only from the law as published in the Gazzetta Ufficiale, never from the DDL. As of 2026-11-22 (GU Serie Generale up to n. 272 of 21-11-2026) the 2027 budget law is not published; re-check after publication, usually around 30 December.

entries.title: Assegno unico: new ISEE by end of February
entries.source_note: The INPS service page sets no 28 February date: applications from 1 March to 30 June get arrears back to March, and an ISEE from a DSU filed by 30 June also counts. No 2027 INPS message yet (2026-11-22). If re-checked, the official anchors are 03-01 and 06-30, not 02-28.

entries.title: Certificazione Unica to employees
entries.source_note: DPR 322/1998 art. 4 c. 6-quater: CU to employees by 16 March of the following year (c. 6-quinquies: also to AdE by 16 March). 16 Mar 2027 is a Tuesday, no shift.

entries.title: Tredicesima (December pay)
entries.source_note: No legal date for employees (CCNL), so 12-15 has no official basis. Pensions: paid on the 1st of the month (L. 190/2014 art. 1 c. 302); no official page read on 2026-11-22 says the tredicesima comes with the December instalment. Candidate anchor 12-01 once the INPS December payslip notice is out.

entries.title: New withholding-tax tables
entries.source_note: ESTV circular no. 221 (20 Oct 2026): 2027 tables valid from 1 January 2027; files expected online in December 2026. Cantonal tables only on each canton's site.

entries.title: Pillar 3a: pay in before 31 December
entries.source_note: Federal announcement of 5 Oct 2026: max CHF 7,258 (with 2nd pillar) for 2026, CHF 7,373 from 1 Jan 2027; without 2nd pillar CHF 36,288 / 36,864.

entries.title: Tax-return deadline 31 March (ZH, BS, GE, AG)
entries.source_note: ZH: 31.03.2027 stated for the 2026 return (ZStB 133.1, 4.8.2026). BS: 31.03.2027 (Wegleitung 2026, media.bs.ch 15500.a.01.26). GE (ge.ch, 'de l'annee en cours') and AG (employees and retirees; self-employed 30.06) state the same standing rule. 31 Mar 2027 is a Wednesday.

entries.title: Tax-return deadline 15 March (BE, VD)
entries.source_note: BE: 15.03 for employees, 15.05 self-employed; the binding date is on the letter sent with the return. VD: 15.03 legal deadline, tolerance to 30.06 (vd.ch). Both pages name no year: check the 2027 letters before marking checked.

entries.title: Tax-return deadline 30 April (ZG, TI)
entries.source_note: ZG: 30.04 (generic page, no year). TI: the 2025 return was due 30.04.2026; the 2026 notice usually comes in February. SG and LU have no fixed date (printed on the form): no entry.
